title: Apprentice Electrician
description: Apprentice electricians learn to install and maintain electrical wiring and equipment under journeyman supervision over a 4-5 year program.

title: Journeyman Electrician
description: Journeyman electricians independently install; maintain; and repair electrical systems in residential; commercial; and industrial settings.

title: Master Electrician
description: Master electricians design electrical systems; pull permits; manage crews; and oversee complex installations requiring advanced code knowledge.

title: Electrical Foreman
description: Electrical foremen supervise crews of 5-15 electricians on commercial and industrial projects; coordinating daily tasks and quality control.

title: Electrical Inspector
description: Electrical inspectors examine electrical installations and systems to ensure compliance with the National Electrical Code and local building codes.

title: Electrical Estimator
description: Electrical estimators analyze blueprints and specifications to prepare detailed cost estimates for electrical construction projects.

title: Data Center Electrician
description: Data center electricians install and maintain critical power systems including UPS; generators; and switchgear in mission-critical facilities.

title: Lineman
description: Linemen install and maintain electrical power lines and distribution systems; working at extreme heights on poles and towers in all weather.

title: Apprentice Plumber
description: Apprentice plumbers learn to install and repair piping systems under journeyman supervision over a 4-5 year registered apprenticeship.

title: Journeyman Plumber
description: Journeyman plumbers independently install; inspect; and repair pipes and plumbing systems for water; gas; and drainage in buildings.

title: Master Plumber
description: Master plumbers design plumbing systems; pull permits; run businesses; and supervise journeymen and apprentices on complex projects.

title: Plumbing Foreman
description: Plumbing foremen supervise plumbing crews on commercial and residential construction projects; managing materials; schedules; and quality.

title: Steamfitter/Pipefitter
description: Steamfitters install and maintain high-pressure piping systems for steam; heating; cooling; and industrial process applications.

title: Medical Gas Plumber
description: Medical gas plumbers install and certify specialized piping systems for oxygen; nitrogen; and other medical gases in healthcare facilities.

title: Apprentice HVAC Technician
description: Apprentice HVAC technicians learn to install and service heating; ventilation; and air conditioning systems under experienced technician supervision.

title: HVAC Installation Technician
description: HVAC installation technicians install new heating and cooling systems in residential and commercial buildings following manufacturer specifications.

title: HVAC Service Technician
description: HVAC service technicians diagnose; troubleshoot; and repair malfunctions in heating; cooling; and ventilation equipment at customer locations.

title: HVAC Supervisor
description: HVAC supervisors manage teams of technicians; oversee project installations; handle scheduling; and ensure quality and safety compliance.

title: Refrigeration Technician
description: Refrigeration technicians install; maintain; and repair commercial and industrial refrigeration systems for food storage and processing.

title: Data Center HVAC Technician
description: Data center HVAC technicians maintain precision cooling systems critical to data center operations; monitoring temperature and humidity controls.

title: Controls/BAS Technician
description: Building automation systems technicians install; program; and maintain computerized controls for HVAC; lighting; and energy management systems.

title: Entry-Level Welder
description: Entry-level welders perform basic MIG and stick welding operations on structural steel and fabrication projects under supervision.

title: Journeyman Welder
description: Journeyman welders independently perform MIG; TIG; stick; and flux-core welding on structural; pipe; and fabrication projects.

title: Certified Pipe Welder
description: Certified pipe welders perform specialized welding on high-pressure piping systems in refineries; power plants; and industrial facilities.

title: Underwater Welder
description: Underwater welders perform wet and dry hyperbaric welding on marine structures; offshore platforms; and underwater pipelines.

title: Welding Inspector (CWI)
description: Certified welding inspectors examine welds for quality and code compliance using visual inspection and non-destructive testing methods.

title: Welding Foreman
description: Welding foremen supervise welding crews on construction and fabrication projects; ensuring quality standards and production schedules are met.

title: Apprentice Carpenter
description: Apprentice carpenters learn framing; finishing; and formwork skills under journeyman supervision through a 3-4 year training program.

title: Journeyman Carpenter
description: Journeyman carpenters independently construct and install wooden structures including framing; trim; cabinetry; and concrete formwork.

title: Finish Carpenter
description: Finish carpenters specialize in trim; molding; doors; windows; and cabinetry installation requiring precision craftsmanship and attention to detail.

title: Formwork Carpenter
description: Formwork carpenters build and set concrete forms for foundations; walls; columns; and other structural elements on construction projects.

title: Carpentry Foreman
description: Carpentry foremen supervise carpentry crews; coordinate with project management; manage materials; and ensure work meets quality standards.

title: Construction Superintendent
description: Construction superintendents oversee entire job sites; managing schedules; safety programs; subcontractor coordination; and client relations.

title: Concrete Finisher
description: Concrete finishers spread; level; and smooth concrete surfaces using trowels; screeds; and finishing tools on construction projects.

title: Concrete Foreman
description: Concrete foremen supervise concrete crews; manage pours; coordinate with other trades; and ensure quality of finished concrete work.

title: Decorative Concrete Specialist
description: Decorative concrete specialists apply stamped; stained; and polished finishes to concrete surfaces for architectural and aesthetic applications.

title: Mason/Bricklayer
description: Masons build and repair walls; floors; and structures using brick; stone; and concrete block; interpreting blueprints for proper layout.

title: Structural Ironworker
description: Structural ironworkers erect steel frameworks for buildings and bridges; connecting beams and columns at extreme heights using bolts and welding.

title: Reinforcing Ironworker
description: Reinforcing ironworkers position and secure rebar in concrete forms for structural reinforcement on foundations; walls; and infrastructure.

title: Ironworker Foreman
description: Ironworker foremen supervise structural and reinforcing iron crews on high-rise and bridge projects; managing safety and production.

title: Ornamental Ironworker
description: Ornamental ironworkers install decorative metalwork including stairs; railings; curtain walls; and architectural metal features on buildings.

title: Sheet Metal Worker
description: Sheet metal workers fabricate and install ductwork; roofing; siding; and other sheet metal components using hand and power tools.

title: Sheet Metal Foreman
description: Sheet metal foremen supervise crews installing HVAC ductwork and architectural sheet metal; managing layouts; materials; and quality.

title: Roofer
description: Roofers install; repair; and replace roofs using shingles; metal; membranes; and other materials; working at heights in all weather conditions.

title: Roofing Foreman
description: Roofing foremen supervise roofing crews; manage material logistics; ensure proper installation techniques; and enforce fall protection safety.

title: Roofing Project Manager
description: Roofing project managers oversee multiple roofing projects; handling estimating; scheduling; client relations; and crew coordination.

title: Glazier
description: Glaziers cut; fit; and install glass in windows; skylights; storefronts; and curtain wall systems on commercial and residential buildings.

title: Journeyman Glazier
description: Journeyman glaziers independently install complex glass systems including curtain walls; skylights; and structural glass facades.

title: Insulation Worker
description: Insulation workers install and replace materials to insulate buildings; pipes; and mechanical systems for energy conservation and temperature control.

title: Mechanical Insulator
description: Mechanical insulators wrap pipes; boilers; and ducts with insulation materials in industrial and commercial settings to control heat and energy loss.

title: Drywall Installer
description: Drywall installers measure; cut; and fasten wallboard panels to metal or wooden studs on interior walls and ceilings.

title: Drywall Taper/Finisher
description: Drywall tapers apply joint compound and tape to seams between panels; then sand surfaces smooth to prepare walls for painting.

title: Commercial Painter
description: Commercial painters prepare surfaces and apply paint; stain; and coatings to walls and structures in commercial buildings and facilities.

title: Industrial Painter
description: Industrial painters apply specialty coatings including epoxy; fire-retardant; and anti-corrosion materials to bridges; tanks; and industrial structures.

title: Painting Foreman
description: Painting foremen supervise painting crews on commercial and industrial projects; managing surface preparation; material usage; and scheduling.

title: Tile Setter
description: Tile setters install ceramic; porcelain; marble; and stone tile on floors; walls; and countertops using mortar; adhesive; and grout.

title: Floor Layer
description: Floor layers install carpet; vinyl; laminate; and hardwood flooring in residential and commercial buildings; preparing substrates and cutting materials.

title: Excavator Operator
description: Excavator operators drive and control hydraulic excavators to dig trenches; foundations; and grade earth on construction and civil projects.

title: Crane Operator
description: Crane operators control mobile and tower cranes to lift and position heavy materials on construction sites; requiring precise coordination and safety focus.

title: Bulldozer Operator
description: Bulldozer operators drive track-type tractors to move earth; clear land; and grade surfaces for construction; road; and mining projects.

title: Heavy Equipment Operator (Senior)
description: Senior heavy equipment operators run multiple machine types and mentor junior operators; commanding premium pay for multi-machine proficiency.

title: Heavy Equipment Foreman
description: Heavy equipment foremen supervise operators and ground crews; coordinate equipment logistics; and manage grading and excavation operations.

title: Pile Driver Operator
description: Pile driver operators position and drive large beams into the ground using specialized equipment to support bridges; buildings; and marine structures.

title: Pipeline Worker
description: Pipeline workers install; maintain; and repair underground and above-ground pipelines that transport oil; gas; and water across regions.

title: Pipeline Welder
description: Pipeline welders perform specialized welding on high-pressure oil and gas pipelines; often traveling to remote locations with per diem pay.

title: Road Construction Worker
description: Road construction workers grade surfaces; operate paving equipment; install drainage; and apply road markings on highway projects.

title: Heavy Highway Superintendent
description: Heavy highway superintendents oversee large road and bridge construction projects; managing crews; schedules; safety; and quality control.

title: Bridge Construction Worker
description: Bridge construction workers build; repair; and maintain bridges; performing structural steel erection; concrete work; and specialized rigging at heights.

title: Tunnel Construction Worker
description: Tunnel construction workers excavate and build tunnels for transportation and utilities using TBMs and drill-and-blast methods in confined spaces.

title: Arborist
description: Arborists assess tree health; perform pruning and removal; diagnose disease and pest problems; and manage tree risk on residential and commercial properties.

title: Tree Care Crew Leader
description: Tree care crew leaders supervise tree trimming and removal crews; operating aerial lifts and chainsaws while ensuring safety protocols are followed.

title: Certified Arborist (Senior)
description: Senior certified arborists manage tree care operations; perform risk assessments; consult on large-scale urban forestry; and supervise multiple crews.

title: Landscaper/Grounds Maintenance
description: Landscapers maintain outdoor spaces including mowing lawns; planting gardens; installing hardscaping; and operating commercial grounds equipment.

title: Pest Control Technician
description: Pest control technicians identify and treat pest infestations in residential and commercial properties using chemicals; traps; and prevention strategies.

title: Elevator Installer Apprentice
description: Elevator installer apprentices learn to assemble and install elevator components through a 4-year program combining on-the-job training and classroom instruction.

title: Elevator Installer/Repairer
description: Elevator installers and repairers assemble; install; maintain; and modernize elevators; escalators; and moving walkways in commercial buildings.

title: Fire Sprinkler Fitter
description: Fire sprinkler fitters design layouts; install piping; and test automatic fire sprinkler systems to ensure fire protection code compliance.

title: Fire Sprinkler Foreman
description: Fire sprinkler foremen supervise installation crews; coordinate with other trades; review blueprints; and manage fire protection system projects.

title: Fire Protection Inspector
description: Fire protection inspectors examine fire sprinkler and suppression systems to verify proper installation; maintenance; and compliance with NFPA codes.

title: Solar Panel Installer
description: Solar PV installers mount solar panels on rooftops and ground arrays; connect wiring to inverters; and test system output for optimal performance.

title: Solar Installation Foreman
description: Solar installation foremen lead crews installing residential and commercial solar arrays; managing site logistics; safety; and system commissioning.

title: Solar Project Manager
description: Solar project managers oversee multiple solar installation projects; handling permitting; scheduling; budgeting; and utility interconnection coordination.

title: Wind Turbine Technician
description: Wind turbine technicians inspect; diagnose; and repair wind turbine components at extreme heights; performing mechanical and electrical maintenance.

title: Wind Turbine Lead Technician
description: Wind turbine lead technicians manage site teams; coordinate turbine maintenance schedules; and handle advanced diagnostics on multi-megawatt turbines.

title: EV Charging Station Installer
description: EV charging station installers design; install; and commission Level 2 and DC fast charging infrastructure for electric vehicle networks.

title: EV Charging Station Supervisor
description: EV charging supervisors manage installation crews; coordinate with utilities and site owners; and oversee multi-site EV infrastructure deployment.

title: Data Center Technician
description: Data center technicians install; maintain; and troubleshoot server infrastructure; cabling; cooling; and electrical systems in data center facilities.

title: Data Center Facilities Engineer
description: Data center facilities engineers manage critical infrastructure including power distribution; cooling systems; and monitoring in mission-critical environments.

title: CNC Machinist (Entry)
description: Entry-level CNC machinists set up and operate computer-controlled lathes and mills to cut and shape metal parts to precise specifications.

title: CNC Machinist (Experienced)
description: Experienced CNC machinists write G-code programs; set up multi-axis machines; and produce precision parts for aerospace; medical; and defense industries.

title: CNC Supervisor
description: CNC supervisors manage machining departments; schedule production runs; maintain quality standards; and train operators on new equipment and programs.

title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
description: Industrial maintenance technicians troubleshoot and repair mechanical; electrical; hydraulic; and pneumatic systems to minimize manufacturing downtime.

title: Industrial Maintenance Supervisor
description: Industrial maintenance supervisors manage maintenance teams; schedule preventive maintenance; coordinate equipment shutdowns; and maintain CMMS records.

title: Millwright
description: Millwrights install; align; and maintain industrial machinery and equipment using precision laser alignment tools; rigging; and fabrication skills.

title: Boilermaker
description: Boilermakers fabricate; install; and repair boilers and pressure vessels in power plants; refineries; and chemical plants following ASME codes.

title: Instrumentation Technician
description: Instrumentation technicians install; calibrate; and repair sensors; transmitters; and control systems used in industrial process automation.

title: Manufacturing Technician
description: Manufacturing technicians set up; operate; and monitor production equipment; ensuring products meet quality standards and production schedules.

title: Quality Control Inspector
description: Quality control inspectors examine products for defects and verify adherence to specifications using measuring instruments; gauges; and testing equipment.

title: Automotive Technician
description: Automotive technicians diagnose; repair; and maintain automobiles; working with computer systems; hybrid powertrains; and advanced driver-assistance systems.

title: Master Automotive Technician
description: Master ASE-certified technicians diagnose complex vehicle issues; perform advanced electrical and hybrid system repairs; and mentor junior technicians.

title: Diesel Technician
description: Diesel technicians maintain and repair diesel engines in trucks; buses; construction equipment; and industrial machinery using diagnostic tools.

title: Heavy Equipment Mechanic
description: Heavy equipment mechanics maintain and repair excavators; bulldozers; cranes; and loaders in shops and in the field at construction sites.

title: Fleet Maintenance Technician
description: Fleet maintenance technicians perform scheduled maintenance and repairs on company vehicle fleets; minimizing downtime and managing upkeep records.

title: Collision Repair Technician
description: Collision repair technicians restore damaged vehicle bodies; straighten frames; replace panels; and refinish surfaces using specialized equipment.

title: Construction Laborer
description: Construction laborers carry materials; clean job sites; assist tradespeople; and operate hand tools as entry-level workers on construction projects.

title: Construction Foreman (General)
description: Construction foremen oversee crews of laborers and tradespeople; coordinating daily tasks; managing materials; and enforcing safety on job sites.

title: Construction Project Manager
description: Construction project managers oversee budgets; contracts; client relationships; and scheduling for commercial and industrial construction projects.

title: Construction Estimator
description: Construction estimators analyze blueprints and specifications to calculate material quantities; labor costs; and timelines for project bidding.

title: Safety Manager (Construction)
description: Construction safety managers develop and implement safety programs; conduct inspections; investigate incidents; and ensure OSHA compliance on job sites.

title: Construction Technology Manager
description: Construction technology managers oversee a firm's technology stack from BIM and drones to robotics and AI scheduling tools for project optimization.

title: BAS/Smart Building Integrator
description: Smart building integrators design and implement building automation systems connecting HVAC; lighting; access; and energy management controls.

title: Commissioning Agent
description: Commissioning agents verify that building systems perform according to design specifications; testing HVAC; electrical; and controls before occupancy.

title: Robotics Maintenance Technician
description: Robotics maintenance technicians program; troubleshoot; and maintain automated welding; assembly; and material handling robots in manufacturing facilities.

title: Semiconductor Fab Technician
description: Semiconductor fab technicians operate and maintain equipment in cleanroom environments for chip manufacturing at TSMC; Intel; and Samsung facilities.

title: Battery Storage Technician
description: Battery storage technicians install; maintain; and troubleshoot lithium-ion battery energy storage systems connected to solar and grid infrastructure.
